data.desc: Pyxis Tankers Inc. currently owns a modern fleet of six mid-sized eco-vessels engaged in the seaborne transportation of a broad range of refined petroleum products and dry-bulk commodities. The fleet consists of three MR product tankers, one Ultramax bulk carrier, and two sister-ship Kamsarmax bulk carriers, one of which is owned through a joint venture in which the Company holds a controlling interest. The Company is positioned to opportunistically expand and maximize its fleet of eco-efficient vessels due to significant capital resources, competitive cost structure, strong customer relationships and an experienced management team whose interests are aligned with those of its shareholders.
